fields.tenant_task: Exclusive compact for a single/couple or other small household with useful work/access routines; actual tenant mix not measured.
fields.payer_and_decisionmaker: Unknown; no nationality, student or third-party-payer premium.
fields.substitutes: Same permitted component and accommodation package; compare exclusive compacts and larger whole units by all-in housing budget. Cross-region capital alternatives are not valuation comparables.
fields.privacy: Advertised studio/furnishing does not authenticate independent entrance, bathroom/kitchen/laundry exclusivity, noise, unrelated sharing, visitor rules or utilities; approved and actual form remain unknown.
fields.management: Current charge bills, service outcomes, reserve funding, arrears and major works unknown. Stable fee/age/marketing claims are not a management grade.
fields.demand: Transport and amenity claims do not establish captured demand; no door-to-destination route, tenant concentration or retention distribution authenticated.
fields.exit: Financeable investor remains eligible; actual borrower terms and normalised resale references unknown. Owner occupation is not a mandatory alternative.
fields.hypothesis: A repeatable ordinary net income may support investor demand at the specified entry, if rights/package and normalised references are validated.
fields.rival_and_falsifier: Low price may reflect stale availability, different use/rights, missing bays, work costs or weak transferable income. An ineligible parcel, lower supported rent, higher cost or normalised reference eliminating the supposed gap defeats the preferred explanation.

divergence.reason: Missing evidence, different packages and model sensitivities do not alone establish material same-proposition evidence/judgment conflict.

investigation_families.data_limitation: Stale caches, redirects, component/category errors and duplicates
investigation_families.judgment_bias: Anchoring on positive annual cash or headline discount
investigation_families.omitted_variable: Rights, bay usability, furnishing scope, fees/works and financeability
investigation_families.structural_change: No new evidenced demand/management change adopted

fields.uncertainty: Higher evidence burden and required margin of safety, lower conviction; no arbitrary numeric discount invented.

note: Common unresolved fields supplement case-specific evidence and next_three records. They do not replace existing historical G0-G9 workpapers.
